wrong.why: The verse makes Jonathan the son of a Shemaiah who is in the line Zechariah, Jonathan, Shemaiah, Mattaniah, Michaiah, so the Levite namesake shemaiah-14 is the wrong person.
This Shemaiah is the grandfather of Zechariah in the verse's genealogy (shemaiah-26), so the shemaiah-14 father-of row is a namesake error and the chapter does not say it.
The Shemaiah and Mattaniah links in this genealogy are shemaiah-26 and mattaniah-12, so these shemaiah-14 rows with mattaniah-4 name the wrong people.
The Jeremiah who went up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua is the family head from Zerubbabel's return (jeremiah-9), whose companion rows already stand, so the jeremiah-7 rows duplicate a namesake.
'Of Jeremiah, Hananiah' names the house of the Jeremiah who continued under Joiakim (jeremiah-9), not the NEH 10:8 priest jeremiah-7.
'Of Melicu, Jonathan' names the house of Malluch that is later called Melicu, which is malluch-6 (the priest who went up with Zerubbabel), not the NEH 10:8 Malluch.
Jonathan belongs to the house of malluch-6, so this malluch-4 row is a namesake and is removed in favour of the retargeted row.
Azarael named among Zechariah's brethren is the musician-priest azarel-6, not Ahzai's son azarel-4 of NEH 11:13.
Maai is one of 'his brethren' together with Shemaiah, the priest with trumpets (shemaiah-27), not the NEH 10:8 priest shemaiah-19.
Jehohanan here is one of the singers at the wall dedication (jehohanan-5), not the son of Amariah in NEH 12:13 (jehohanan-4).
'Of Shemaiah, Jehonathan' names the house of the Shemaiah who returned with Zerubbabel and headed a priestly house (shemaiah-24), not the NEH 10:8 priest shemaiah-19.
This shemaiah-19 link is a namesake of the house head in this verse and duplicates the shemaiah-24 link once 105526 is retargeted.
'Of Jedaiah, Nethaneel' names the Jedaiah house later headed by Nethaneel (jedaiah-8), not jedaiah-5, who is named at NEH 11:10 and 12:7.

'Johanan the son of Eliashib' names the son of the high priest Eliashib of NEH 12:10, and no row links the two.
